subject: Security profile refresh and proof-of-control request
messages:
From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@quokkapay.com>
To: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@quokkapay.com
Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: profile refresh + evidence for procurement

Hi Priyom,

We’re in the final stages of QuokkaPay’s vendor procurement and need to refresh a few items on your Whistic/OneTrust profile so legal/procurement can close. Our security team flagged a couple missing proof-of-control items for SOC 2 / SIG:

- Most recent SOC 2 Type II report (we need the PDF, redacted OK)
- Network segmentation diagram for production (high level)
- Access control matrix showing admin roles and MFA enforcement date
- Updated SIG answers (CSV) where you indicate encryption at rest for PII

Can you get these to us by EOD Friday? If some of this requires an internal owner, please point me at who I should follow up with.

Appreciate it — Daniel
Security Program Manager
QuokkaPay

From: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@quokkapay.com>
Cc: mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 04 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: profile refresh + evidence for procurement

Thanks Daniel — we can do that.

Quick plan: I’ll own the package and coordinate uploads to Whistic. Mina, can you assemble the SOC2 PDF and access-control matrix? Rishi, can you pull the network diagram and confirm the encryption at rest language we use in SIG answers?

If we can get everything by Thursday EOD Pacific, I’ll upload and send you the Whistic link for signoff.

- Priyom
Product Security, Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 05 Nov 2025 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: profile refresh + evidence for procurement

Priyom — attaching the current artifacts we have ready: SOC2_TypeII_report_2024.pdf (redacted), access-control-matrix.xlsx. Note on the matrix: admin role columns include dates for when SSO + MFA went live (June 2024).

I don’t have a production network segmentation PNG that’s appropriate for external sharing — the architecture diagram we normally use contains vendor-specific IPs. Rishi, can you produce a sanitized diagram that shows VLAN/segment boundaries and the public/private service tiers? If not, I can provide a written summary and a cropped high-level image.

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_report_2024.pdf (PDF), access-control-matrix.xlsx (XLSX)

— Mina
Security Operations

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com, priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 06 Nov 2025 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: profile refresh + evidence for procurement

I can produce a sanitized network-segmentation-diagram.png and export the SIG answers CSV. A couple of clarifications before I generate:

1) For encryption at rest phrasing, do we want the strict customer-data wording ("All customer PII is encrypted at rest using AES-256; key material managed in our KMS with rotation policy") or the broader platform wording that references database-level encryption? Quokka’s request called out PII specifically.

2) Do we want to include cloud firewall rule examples (high-level) in the diagram or keep it purely network zones and trust boundaries?

If you’re OK with the PII-specific language, I’ll craft the CSV with that explicit statement and export the sanitized PNG by Friday morning.

— Rishi
Applied ML / Infrastructure Security

Date: Fri, 07 Nov 2025 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Final upload: Whistic profile update + artifacts

Daniel / Samantha — we uploaded the refreshed profile and artifacts to Whistic this afternoon. Summary:

- SOC2_TypeII_report_2024.pdf (redacted) — attached to the profile
- network-segmentation-diagram.png — sanitized high-level diagram (no vendor IPs)
- access-control-matrix.xlsx — exported from our IAM tool with admin role timestamps
- SIG-responses-2025.csv — updated answer for encryption-at-rest (explicit AES-256 / KMS rotation wording)

Whistic link: https://whistic.com/profile/quokkapay-redwood-2025 (read-only view)
Doc owners: Mina (SOC2, ACL matrix), Rishi (network diagram, SIG export), Priyom (profile and coordination).

If procurement needs anything redacted further or there are follow-ups, loop me in and we’ll expedite.

Thanks — Priyom
Product Security, Redwood Inference
